description: Retrieve the current Runtime Activation Payload — the machine-readable contract that governs what tools, files, and domains an agent is permitted to access for the active task. Use to understand task scope, allowed tool surface, risk posture, and enforcement rules before beginning implementation. This is the authoritative scope document for the session.

evidence_preview.description: Opt into the pilot committed source preview and capture its revision-bound Evidence Receipt.

repoRoot.description: Absolute path to the repo root. Defaults to CODELEDGER_REPO_ROOT or git root.

source_windows.description: Optional follow-up. Read small committed source windows from files selected or referenced by the fresh activation. Returns the windows and provenance without repeating the bundle.

anchor.description: Literal, case-insensitive text identifying a source line.

lines.description: Maximum lines. Anchor lookups include up to four preceding lines.

path.description: Exact repository-relative path from the activation scope.

start_line.description: One-based first source line. Use a line from matching_lines when an anchor is ambiguous. Omit anchor.

name: get_activation_payload
